name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage found 8 to 10 Nov
state: StatusGator showed the monitored Cloudflare service operational on 10 Nov at 17:42 UTC, with no user outage reports in the prior 24 hours and no incident logged since 22 Oct. Searches for 8 to 10 Nov found no major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage, so the level stays Normal.

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
